admin.ideas.help: Drag a card to another column, or focus its handle and press the left and right arrow keys. Accepted is the work queue: most urgent first.
admin.ideas.unreadable: Records not shown: {n}. Their status or kind is not one this page knows.
admin.ideas.down.store: The ideas file on the server cannot be read right now, so the board cannot be shown or changed. Nothing is lost and nothing was changed; the Scenes tab works. An agent can check data/ideas.json on the server, then press Try again.
admin.ideas.down.disabled: The ideas store is not set up on this server. The Scenes tab works.
admin.ideas.mail.changed: This e-mail changed meanwhile (another tab, Telegram or an agent). The card now shows it as it is.
admin.ideas.setup.noMail: Gmail is not set up on the server: e-mails wait until it is, then each one asks for your Send.
admin.ideas.setup.bot: Telegram works both ways: you can answer and move reports right from the chat.
admin.ideas.setup.noBot: Telegram only receives reports (the server has no webhook secret): they arrive as plain text, without buttons.
admin.ideas.urgency.label: Urgency
admin.ideas.filter.search: Search the words, a contact, an id…
admin.ideas.filter.contact.label: Contact
admin.ideas.filter.landing.label: Landing
admin.ideas.note.title: Write down an idea a pilot told you
admin.ideas.card.diagSkipped: Technical details were not stored: the disk was full.
admin.ideas.comment.placeholder: A note for yourself or for the work
admin.ideas.public.title: On the landing
admin.ideas.public.saved: Saved. Visitors see it on their next visit.
admin.ideas.public.missing: No title in {langs} yet: the landing shows the English one there.
admin.ideas.public.needTitle: Write the English title first: without it the landing does not show the idea.
admin.ideas.public.needStatus: It appears once the idea is accepted, in progress or done.
admin.ideas.reply.title: Reply by e-mail
admin.ideas.reply.to: To {email}, from your Gmail. The pilot's message is quoted below your answer.
admin.ideas.reply.queued: Reply to {email} queued: it goes in {s} s, until then you can cancel it on the card.
admin.ideas.reply.waiting: Reply to {email} saved but not sent: Gmail is not set up on the server. Once it is, press Send next to it on the card.
admin.ideas.reply.noEmail: The pilot left no e-mail address, so there is no one to write to.
admin.ideas.mail.state.waiting_setup: waiting for Gmail to be set up
admin.ideas.thanks.title: Thank the pilot
admin.ideas.thanks.lead: Tell the pilot what was done and how. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
admin.ideas.thanks.summaryLabel: What was done and how, as the pilot will read it ({lang})
admin.ideas.thanks.noEmail: Marked done. The pilot left no e-mail, so there is nothing to send.
admin.ideas.thanks.subject: Subject
admin.ideas.thanks.body: The e-mail as it will go
admin.ideas.thanks.notSent: Not sent yet: {state}. Send tries again.
admin.ideas.thanks.stale: A newer draft replaced the one that was open. Read it, then press Send again.
admin.ideas.thanks.gone: The thank-you was changed elsewhere meanwhile; the card shows where it is now.
admin.ideas.thanks.queued: Thank-you to {email} queued: it goes in {s} s, until then you can cancel it on the card.
admin.ideas.thanks.waiting: Thank-you to {email} saved but not sent: Gmail is not set up on the server. Once it is, press Send next to it on the card.
